ai_workshop_model.tooltip: 仅用于贞贞的AI工坊。默认 gemini-3.5-flash；选择 Custom 后填写下方模型 ID。

first_frame.tooltip: Required by I2VA and FL2VA.

last_frame.tooltip: Required by FL2VA and L2VA.

reference_image.tooltip: Ref2VA reference image.

reference_video.tooltip: Ref2VA 参考视频：节点不限制单段或合计时长；渠道和模型资源限制仍适用。 / No per-video or total duration cap in this enhancer; provider/model resource limits still apply.

reference_context.tooltip: Supplemental identity/relationship facts or narrow reference roles, for example character, scene, or typography-only references.

constraints.tooltip: Content that must be preserved or must not be added/changed, including exact lyrics, text safety, or forbidden transitions.

api_key.tooltip: Accepts a connected STRING or the masked field below. A connected value takes priority. Environment fallback depends on API mode.

reference_template.display_name: 参考模板（参考模式必填）
reference_template.tooltip: Provides shot structure, pacing, camera, style, and sound references. The user's prompt and media remain authoritative.

custom_model.tooltip: OpenAI兼容模式必填；AI工坊选择 Custom 时使用。填写供应商模型列表中的完整 ID。

openai_base_url.tooltip: Provider root, /v1 URL, or full /chat/completions URL. Used only in OpenAI-compatible mode.

openai_video_urls.display_name: OpenAI 视频素材 URL（可选）
openai_video_urls.tooltip: 每行一个，按已连接 VIDEO 顺序以 video_url 透传（仅用于明确支持视频部件的渠道）。未填写或未覆盖的视频自动抽帧为 image_url（适配 llama.cpp 等仅图像端点）。图片始终内联 Base64。

seed.tooltip: 控制 ComfyUI 重跑，并把当前值作为提示词变体标识。供应商未公开 Chat Completions 的确定性种子参数。

local_model.tooltip: 仅本地模式使用。扫描 ComfyUI/models/LLM 根目录中的 GGUF，以及名称含 qwen（不区分大小写）的直接子目录内的 GGUF。

local_mmproj.tooltip: 仅本地图片/视频采样帧分析使用；AUTO 会按 GGUF 元数据匹配主模型。

local_context_size.tooltip: 输入文字、视觉部件、思考和最终正文共享此上下文；数值越大，占用的内存/显存越多。

local_max_tokens.display_name: 本地单次生成 Token（含思考）
local_max_tokens.tooltip: 这是思考过程与最终提示词的生成上限。输入文字及已连接的图/视频会优先保留，必要时自动下调本次实际生成上限；如需同时保留多图和较长输出，请提高本地上下文 Token。

local_video_sample_fps.tooltip: 只分析按真实时间戳采样的画面，不读取视频音轨。

options: 不主动释放 ComfyUI 模型

performance_director_config.tooltip: 不连接时为条件式 AUTO；可连接 T8 Performance Director Config 选择强化或关闭。不会新增付费请求。

provider_config.display_name: 共享 LLM 渠道配置（可选）
provider_config.tooltip: 不连接时完全使用本节点原有字段；连接后使用共享配置，断开即恢复。

character_performance_bible.tooltip: 连接 T8 Character Performance Bible；不新增请求，只向本次人物表演编译提供权威目标、阻力、策略和身体惯性。

relay_event_count.display_name: Relay 事件数（0=自动；非镜头数）

relay_duration_seconds.display_name: Relay 精确秒数（0=沿用目标时长）

relay_time_ranges.tooltip: 每行十进制秒 start-end，例如 0-2.5。留空自动安排；填写时必须连续覆盖成片时长。24 FPS，补齐帧只延续结尾。

director_skill.display_name: 定向创作 Skill（T8，非官方） / Directional Skill
director_skill.tooltip: 默认关闭，保留旧行为。开启时仅暂停其他场景模板，H3格式和用户事实不变；关闭恢复。长镜头需要1或AUTO镜头数。

quality_mode.tooltip: Off保留原行为；Check只检查；Repair精确修协议，最多追加1次LLM纠正。失败保留完整稿，详情见脱敏诊断；不代表成片通过。
options: 质量纠正（最多追加1次） / Repair

creation_mode.tooltip: 原有编排不变；因果优化在同一次生成中补动作衔接与状态继承，不新增规划请求，不覆盖原事实、台词、镜头数及结束状态。

combat_camera_config.display_name: 战斗运镜配置（可选） / Combat camera
combat_camera_config.tooltip: 连接 T8 战斗运镜配置；未连接保持原逻辑，可与表演导演叠加。

MiniMaxH3PromptEnhancerT8.name: MiniMaxH3PromptEnhancerT8
MiniMaxH3PromptEnhancerT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Prompt Enhancer (Cloud / Local GGUF)
MiniMaxH3PromptEnhancerT8.description: Uses one selected cloud or local visual LLM channel to rewrite a prompt into the official MiniMax-H3 T2VA, I2VA, FL2VA, L2VA, Ref2VA or T8 Hybrid (keyframes + visual references) format. Cloud channels receive complete videos; local Qwen reads ordered timestamped visual samples and never claims to analyze the video audio track.

prompt.display_name: 视频创意 / 提示词（必填）
prompt.tooltip: Normally this is the only text you need. Connected images/videos are analyzed by the LLM.

options: 多模态参考生成（图片/视频）

duration_seconds.tooltip: 输入 AUTO 或任意正整数时长；节点不设上限。只控制提示词整体信息密度，不强制逐镜头秒数；实际生成时长取决于下游模型。

shot_count.tooltip: AUTO 或固定 1-20 个镜头；使用镜头N顺序，不生成绝对时间码。高镜头数可能被上游合并，不视为节点错误。

case_template.display_name: 非官方模板（案例 / 社区 Skill）
case_template.tooltip: 选择后显示用途、输入格式、推荐示例、结构锚点和本地 GIF。迁移 Creative DNA 与因果节奏，不复制源人物、剧情、文案、镜头表或媒体。

LazySwitch.name: LazySwitch
LazySwitch.description: Outputs on_true when boolean is true, else on_false. Lazy: only the selected branch executes — every node feeding the unselected side is skipped entirely, saving its compute. An unconnected selected side outputs None instead of erroring, and blocked (muted) branches can be picked back up by selecting the other side. Drive the boolean from a gate's 'present' output to switch automatically.

ProPostDepthMapBlur.name: ProPostDepthMapBlur
ProPostDepthMapBlur.description:
blur_strength: Represents the blur strength. This parameter controls the overall intensity of the blur effect; the higher the value, the more blurred the image becomes.

    focal_depth: Represents the focal depth. This parameter is used to determine which depth level in the image should remain sharp, while other levels are blurred based on depth differences.

    focus_spread: Represents the focus spread range. This parameter controls the size of the blur transition area near the focal depth; the larger the value, the wider the transition area, and the smoother the blur effect spreads around the focus.

    steps: Represents the number of steps in the blur process. This parameter determines the calculation precision of the blur effect; the more steps, the finer the blur effect, but this also increases the computational load.

    focal_range: Represents the focal range. This parameter is used to adjust the depth range within the focal depth that remains sharp; the larger the value, the wider the area around the focal depth that remains sharp.
    
    mask_blur: Represents the mask blur strength for blurring the depth map. This parameter controls the intensity of the depth map's blur treatment, used for preprocessing the depth map before calculating the final blur effect, to achieve a more natural blur transition.

With a preset active this scales the preset own strength, so 1.0 is the preset as designed. Does not scale rim_amplification or mask_blur - those have their own controls

index.tooltip: The step number used to choose from the list. In index mode this wraps around automatically: with 5 items, index 0 selects item 1, index 4 selects item 5, and index 5 starts over at item 1. In random modes, this still acts like the current step so each frame/batch/index can pick a different item.

items.default:
slow push in
wide orbit
handheld follow
low angle reveal
crane up
items.tooltip: The list of text choices to pick from. Works with one item per line, blank-line-separated chunks, comma-separated text, pipe-separated text, JSON arrays like ["push in", "orbit left"], Python-style lists/sets, or JSON objects with an items/values/motions key. Example: slow push in, orbit left, handheld follow.

label.tooltip: Optional name placed before the selected text in the formatted output. Example label Camera Motion outputs: Camera Motion = slow push in. Leave blank if you only want the selected text with no prefix.

max_items.tooltip: Optional limit for how many parsed list items are used. Leave at 0 to use the full list automatically. Example: if the list has 20 items and max_items is 5, only the first 5 items are used and the index loops through those 5.

split_mode.tooltip: How to split the items text into a list. Auto tries JSON/Python first, then detects blank lines, commas, pipes, or normal lines. Use line for one item per line, blank line for paragraph/chunk lists, comma for a,b,c, pipe for a|b|c, or json/python for structured input only.

selection_mode.tooltip: How items are chosen. index selects by index and wraps around the list. random picks a seeded random item for each index. random no repeat creates a seeded shuffled order, walks through every item once, then reshuffles for the next cycle. Example with 5 items: indexes 0-4 use all 5 in random order before any item repeats.

seed.tooltip: Controls the random order for random and random no repeat modes. Same seed plus same index gives the same result, which makes workflows repeatable. Change the seed to get a different random order. Ignored by normal index mode.

multi_format.tooltip: How multiple selected items are combined in formatted_text. auto uses the two_item_template when pick_count is 2, otherwise it uses commas. lines outputs each selected item on its own line. comma outputs item1, item2, item3. sentence uses the two_item_template for exactly 2 items.

two_item_template.tooltip: Editable sentence template used when pick_count is 2 and multi_format is auto or sentence. Keep {item1} and {item2} where you want the selected items inserted. You can also use {items} for both items joined by commas. Example: begin with {item1}, then transition into {item2}.

keep_empty.tooltip: Whether blank entries count as selectable items. Usually leave this off. If off, blank lines are ignored. If on, blank lines can be selected and may output an empty value, for example: Camera Motion = .

pick_count.tooltip: How many items to select at once. Use 1 for a single motion. Use 2 to combine two motions, such as: Camera Motion = start with slow push in then follow with orbit left. For more than 2, the selected items can be output as lines or comma-separated text.

picker_count.tooltip: How many independent cycling text pickers to use. Set 0 to disable advanced prompt details.

joiner.tooltip: How to combine the active formatted_text outputs into combined_formatted_text.

text.tooltip:
What you want the model to say.
For cloning modes, this is the new target speech, not the transcript of your reference clip.

mode.tooltip:
Choose how VoxCPM2 should speak:
- text_to_speech: regular TTS with no voice reference.
- voice_design: zero-shot styled speech guided by your wording alone.
- prompt_continuation: continue from a prompt clip using prompt_audio plus prompt_text.
- controllable_clone: easiest voice clone. Provide a clean reference clip.
- ultimate_clone: strongest cloning mode. Provide a reference clip and the exact transcript in prompt_text.

device.tooltip:
auto picks CUDA when available and falls back to CPU.
CUDA is strongly recommended for VoxCPM2.

cfg_value.tooltip:
Classifier-free guidance strength.
A good starting point is 2.0. Lower can sound looser; higher can sound more forced.

inference_timesteps.tooltip:
Number of inference steps.
10 is a solid default. Higher may improve quality slightly but is slower.

load_denoiser.tooltip:
Optional cleanup for noisy prompt or reference audio before cloning.
Useful if your source clip has hiss, room noise, or light background noise.

normalize_text.tooltip:
Normalize text before generation.
Can help with number/date expansion and cleaner pronunciation on some inputs.

retry_badcase.tooltip:
Retry obviously bad generations automatically.
This can improve reliability but may take longer.

retry_badcase_max_times.tooltip: Maximum retry attempts when retry_badcase is enabled.

retry_badcase_ratio_threshold.tooltip:
Bad-case threshold for retry logic.
Leave this alone unless you are tuning generation behavior.

min_len.tooltip:
Minimum generated audio token length.
Usually safe to leave at the default.

max_len.tooltip:
Maximum generated token length.
Increase if long text is getting cut off. Higher values can use more VRAM and time.

save_filename_prefix.tooltip: Base name for the saved WAV file in ComfyUI/output/VRGDG_AudioFiles.

reference_audio.tooltip:

Use a clean single-speaker clip, ideally 10 to 30 seconds.

video_frames.tooltip: Connect the IMAGE output from VHS Load Video. The complete batch is scanned for one primary face and retained for final full-resolution compositing.

detection_confidence.tooltip: Minimum confidence accepted from the face detector. Higher values reduce false detections but may miss small, blurry, profile, or motion-blurred faces. Lower cautiously for distant faces. Recommended starting value: 0.70.

crop_padding.tooltip: Extra area around the detected face, measured as a fraction of face size on every side. Lower values crop closer to facial features; higher values include more hair, neck, and background. Recommended starting range: 0.10–0.25.

minimum_face_pixels.tooltip: Reject detections whose width or height is smaller than this many source pixels. Raising this filters tiny false positives; lowering it permits very distant faces but increases false-detection risk. Recommended starting value: 20.

rotation_assist.tooltip: Also scans rotated copies of each frame, then maps detections back to the original coordinates. Light helps mildly tilted/overhead faces at roughly 3× detection work. Strong adds ±30° for difficult angles at roughly 5× detection work. It affects detection only; output frames are never rotated.

repair_distance.tooltip: Controls which face sizes are repaired. Very Far fully repairs below 4% of frame width and fades out by 6%. Far fully repairs below 7% and fades out by 9%. Far and Medium fully repairs below 10% and fades out by 12%. All disables distance filtering. Close faces above the fade limit remain unchanged and are not selected as Z-Image anchors.

custom_distance_threshold.tooltip: Used only when Repair Distance is Custom. Faces at or above this percentage of frame width remain unchanged. Repair fades in across the 2 percentage points below this value. Example: 9% gives full repair at 7% or smaller, fading to no repair at 9%.

anchor_interval.tooltip: Approximate spacing between Z-Image identity/detail anchors. Smaller intervals create more anchors and stronger consistency but take longer. Larger intervals are faster but give LTX less identity guidance. The nearest valid detected face is used, and boundary anchors are included automatically.

short_gap_tracking.tooltip: How many consecutive missed detections may reuse the last known face position. Strength fades across the gap. Use 0 to repair only freshly detected frames. The default 2 bridges brief blur without pasting a face into long no-face sections.

warm_up_frames.tooltip: Disposable copies added before the real face video. The first strong image guide is moved onto this outer boundary and the warm-up frames are trimmed after LTX. Use 8 to reduce an over-strong first real frame; use 0 for the original start behavior.

cool_down_frames.tooltip: Minimum disposable copies added after the real face video. The last strong image guide is moved onto this outer boundary and the cool-down frames are trimmed after LTX. Face Fix may add up to seven more hidden frames for 8n+1 alignment and always keeps an eight-frame tail safety guard.

VRGDGVideoEnhanceCollectLTXInputs.name: VRGDGVideoEnhanceCollectLTXInputs
VRGDGVideoEnhanceCollectLTXInputs.description: Validates both Video Enhance branches, adjusts LTX-incompatible conditioning positions, and exposes the paths and dimensions required by the LTX workflow.

ltx_enhanced_frames.tooltip: Connect the final decoded IMAGE batch from LTX. These temporary working-resolution frames are resized back to the exact source dimensions.

video_enhance_context.tooltip: Connect Collect LTX Inputs context. It contains the untouched source frames, exact source dimensions, and frame count.

resize_method.tooltip: Interpolation used to restore LTX frames to the exact source width and height. This changes dimensions only; optional AI upscalers may be inserted before this node if desired.

enhancement_strength.tooltip: Blends the restored LTX result with the untouched original video. 1 uses the complete LTX result; lower values retain more original pixels and can reduce over-processing.

VRGDGVideoEnhanceRestoreOriginal.name: VRGDGVideoEnhanceRestoreOriginal
VRGDGVideoEnhanceRestoreOriginal.description: Restores decoded LTX output to the exact input resolution and frame count, preserving unmatched source-tail frames and optionally blending with the untouched source video.

VRGDG_LTX25MSRReferenceLoader.name: VRGDG_LTX25MSRReferenceLoader
VRGDG_LTX25MSRReferenceLoader.description: Loads up to four subjects and an optional background as separate still images for ComfyUI-LTX2.5-MSR Multi-Reference Guide.

image_count.tooltip: How many dynamic image inputs to show and compose.

columns.tooltip: Uniform grid columns. Use 0 for auto. Some presets ignore this.

image1.tooltip: Ingredient image 1.

image2.tooltip: Ingredient image 2.

image3.tooltip: Ingredient image 3.

image4.tooltip: Ingredient image 4.

image5.tooltip: Ingredient image 5.

image6.tooltip: Ingredient image 6.

image7.tooltip: Ingredient image 7.

image8.tooltip: Ingredient image 8.

image9.tooltip: Ingredient image 9.

image10.tooltip: Ingredient image 10.

image11.tooltip: Ingredient image 11.

image12.tooltip: Ingredient image 12.

image13.tooltip: Ingredient image 13.

image14.tooltip: Ingredient image 14.

image15.tooltip: Ingredient image 15.

VRGDG_LTXICIngredientsGrid.name: VRGDG_LTXICIngredientsGrid
VRGDG_LTXICIngredientsGrid.description: Builds an LTX IC-LoRA Ingredients-style reference sheet from dynamic image inputs.

VRGDG_LTXFirstLastGuide.name: VRGDG_LTXFirstLastGuide
VRGDG_LTXFirstLastGuide.display_name: VRGDG LTX First / Last Temporal Guide

VRGDG_LTXFirstLastEndpointGuide.name: VRGDG_LTXFirstLastEndpointGuide
VRGDG_LTXFirstLastEndpointGuide.display_name: VRGDG LTX First / Last Endpoint Guide

model.tooltip: The diffusion model to use.

vae.tooltip: The VAE to use.

sigmas.tooltip: The sigmas to use.

guider.tooltip: The guider to use, must be a STGGuiderAdvanced.

latents.tooltip: The latents to use for creating the long video, they can be guiding latents or empty latents when no guidance is used.

temporal_tile_size.tooltip: The size of the temporal tile to use for the sampling, in pixel frames, in addition to the overlapping region.

temporal_overlap.tooltip: The overlap between the temporal tiles, in pixel frames.

guiding_strength.tooltip: The strength of the conditioning on guiding latents, when optional_guiding_latents are provided.

temporal_overlap_cond_strength.tooltip: The strength of the conditioning on the latents from the previous temporal tile.

cond_image_strength.tooltip: The strength of the conditioning on the optional_cond_images.

optional_cond_images.tooltip: The image to use for conditioning the first frame in the video (i2v setup). If not provided, the first frame will be unconditioned (t2v setup). The image will be resized to the size of the first frame.

optional_guiding_latents.tooltip: The latents to use for guiding the sampling, typically with an IC-LoRA.

adain_factor.tooltip: The strength of the AdaIn operation used to fix the statistics of each new generated temporal tile, to prevent accumulated oversaturation.

optional_positive_conditionings.tooltip: Optional way to provide changing positive prompts, one per temporal tile, using the MultiPromptProvider node.

optional_negative_index_latents.tooltip: Special optional latents to condition on a negative index before each new temporal tile as a way to provide long term context during video generation.

guiding_start_step.tooltip: The step at which the guiding latents start to be used.

guiding_end_step.tooltip: The step at which the guiding latents stop to be used.

optional_cond_image_indices.tooltip: The indices of the keyframes to use for the sampling, separated by commas. The indices are counted from the end of the video.

optional_normalizing_latents.tooltip: The latents to use for normalizing the output latents, they will be used to normalize the output latents to the same statistics as the input latents.

use_scheduled_strengths.tooltip: Enable the three comma-separated strength schedules. When disabled, the original scalar strength widgets behave exactly like the official node.

cond_image_strength_schedule.tooltip: Comma-separated conditioning-image strengths, one per temporal tile. Example: 1.0,0.6,0.3. The last value repeats when there are more tiles. A tile's value applies to every keyframe routed into that tile.

guiding_strength_schedule.tooltip: Comma-separated optional-guiding-latent strengths, one per temporal tile. Example: 0.8,0.5,0.3. The last value repeats.

temporal_overlap_cond_strength_schedule.tooltip: Comma-separated overlap-conditioning strengths. The first value belongs to the first extension boundary (tile 1); later values follow later boundaries. Example: 0.8,0.65,0.5. The last value repeats.

VRGDG_LTXVLoopingSamplerAdvanced.name: VRGDG_LTXVLoopingSamplerAdvanced
VRGDG_LTXVLoopingSamplerAdvanced.description: LTXV Looping Sampler with optional per-temporal-tile schedules for image guidance, latent guidance, and overlap conditioning. The official LTX node is not modified.

av_latent.tooltip: Joint AV latent from MiniMax H3 Reference/Image to Video.

source_audio.tooltip: Audio that should drive the video and remain unchanged in the final mux.

audio_vae.tooltip: MiniMax H3 audio VAE used to place the source audio in the AV latent.

VRGDG_MiniMaxH3AudioDrive.name: VRGDG_MiniMaxH3AudioDrive
VRGDG_MiniMaxH3AudioDrive.description: Replaces MiniMax H3's blank generated-audio latent with an encoded source track, locks that audio with a zero denoise mask, and passes the original AUDIO through unchanged for the final video mux. Keep the same AUDIO connected to ref_audio_0 and reference it as <Audio 1> in the prompt.

reference_image.tooltip: Character reference: <Picture 1> when connected.

location_image.tooltip: Location reference: <Picture 2> with a character reference, otherwise <Picture 1>.

use_built_in_audio.tooltip: Generate audio per chunk and continue previous audio when a motion prefix exists.

first_frame.tooltip: Optional opening frame, stretched like native H3 Image to Video. Overrides previous visual context to start a new shot. Built-in audio may still continue across the cut.

last_frame.tooltip: Optional endpoint, center-cropped like native H3 Image to Video. Anchors the last retained frame, before discarded padding. Works with previous-motion context.

VRGDG_MiniMaxH3ConnectedChunk.name: VRGDG_MiniMaxH3ConnectedChunk
VRGDG_MiniMaxH3ConnectedChunk.description: Connected H3 chunks with optional first/last image anchors and motion history. Built-in audio continues audio history; OFF locks the source soundtrack.

VRGDG_MiniMaxH3FinishChunk.name: VRGDG_MiniMaxH3FinishChunk
VRGDG_MiniMaxH3FinishChunk.description: Trim matching audio/video prefixes and padding, assemble on CPU, and retain motion history. Select generated or source audio automatically from the chunk plan.

VRGDG_MiniMaxH3PrepareCleanAudio.name: VRGDG_MiniMaxH3PrepareCleanAudio
VRGDG_MiniMaxH3PrepareCleanAudio.display_name: VRGDG H3 Fresh Audio / Fixed Video (Advanced)
VRGDG_MiniMaxH3PrepareCleanAudio.description: Discard Turbo audio, hold sampled video fixed, and initialize fresh audio plus previous waveform context for a separate clean-model sampler.

VRGDG_LongShotLLMContext.name: VRGDG_LongShotLLMContext
VRGDG_LongShotLLMContext.description: Combines the H3 guide, story, exact dialogue or lyrics, audio mode, timing, frame roles, and previous chunk prompt into one multimodal LLM instruction string.

VRGDG_LongShotAutoDirectorContext.name: VRGDG_LongShotAutoDirectorContext
VRGDG_LongShotAutoDirectorContext.description: Creates one multimodal LLM request for a complete LongShot story plan. Connect its output to VRGDG LLM Multi and attach up to two planning reference images there.

VRGDG_LongShotPlanExtractor.name: VRGDG_LongShotPlanExtractor
VRGDG_LongShotPlanExtractor.description: Extracts one chunk's existing LongShot LLM inputs from an Auto Director JSON plan.

VRGDG_LongShotKeyframeDirectorContext.name: VRGDG_LongShotKeyframeDirectorContext
VRGDG_LongShotKeyframeDirectorContext.description: Creates one LLM request for four coordinated 16:9 LongShot keyframe prompts.

VRGDG_LongShotKeyframePromptExtractor.name: VRGDG_LongShotKeyframePromptExtractor
VRGDG_LongShotKeyframePromptExtractor.description: Extracts four standalone image prompts from Keyframe Director JSON.

VRGDG_LongShotCollectFourKeyframes.name: VRGDG_LongShotCollectFourKeyframes
VRGDG_LongShotCollectFourKeyframes.description: Waits for all four images, exposes their LongShot roles, and builds a preview batch.

tile_batch_size.tooltip: Spatial tiles decoded together. Uses more VRAM. 1 runs stock decoding.

H3FastVAEDecode.name: H3FastVAEDecode
H3FastVAEDecode.description: Experimental H3 video decode with batched spatial tiles; preserves stock temporal processing and blending.

VRGDG_MiniMaxH3LatentUpscaleModelLoader.name: VRGDG_MiniMaxH3LatentUpscaleModelLoader
VRGDG_MiniMaxH3LatentUpscaleModelLoader.display_name: Load MiniMax H3 Learned Latent Upscaler

VRGDG_MiniMaxH3ReplaceUpscaledVideoLaten.name: VRGDG_MiniMaxH3ReplaceUpscaledVideoLatent
VRGDG_MiniMaxH3ReplaceUpscaledVideoLaten.display_name: MiniMax H3 Replace with Upscaled Video Latent

VRGDGOverlapPreset.name: VRGDGOverlapPreset
VRGDGOverlapPreset.description: Creates validated H3 overlap settings. Connect stride to the standard VHS Batch Manager's frames_per_batch input and overlap_config to Build Overlap Window.

VRGDGOverlapMetaBatchManager.name: VRGDGOverlapMetaBatchManager
VRGDGOverlapMetaBatchManager.display_name: DEPRECATED - VRGDG Overlap Meta Batch Manager
VRGDGOverlapMetaBatchManager.description: Deprecated: VideoHelperSuite requeues only its native VHS_BatchManager class. Use VRGDG Overlap Preset plus the standard VHS Batch Manager instead.

VRGDGOverlapWindow.name: VRGDGOverlapWindow
VRGDGOverlapWindow.description: Prepends the prior source tail and pads the final window so the model always sees the preset H3 frame count.

VRGDGOverlapAudioWindow.name: VRGDGOverlapAudioWindow
VRGDGOverlapAudioWindow.description: Slices the source soundtrack to the exact overlap window being processed. Synthetic leading and trailing video frames receive silence.

VRGDGOverlapBlend.name: VRGDGOverlapBlend
VRGDGOverlapBlend.description: Cosine/smoothstep/linear blends matching processed overlap frames, holds the next tail, and emits every original source frame exactly once.

VRGDGLongVideoMetaBatchLoader.name: VRGDGLongVideoMetaBatchLoader
VRGDGLongVideoMetaBatchLoader.display_name: VRGDG Long Video Upload + Meta Batch

VRGDGEnsureVideoAudio.name: VRGDGEnsureVideoAudio
VRGDGEnsureVideoAudio.description: Passes readable source audio through unchanged. If a video has no readable audio stream, creates silence matching the source-video duration so audio-dependent workflows can continue.

image_paths.tooltip: Ordered MiniMax H3 reference images. Use a JSON list, an object with image_paths/images, or one path per line. Supports up to 9 images.

video_references.tooltip: Ordered MiniMax H3 reference videos. Use a JSON list of paths or objects with path, start_seconds, duration, and use_audio. Supports up to 3 videos.

VRGDG_MiniMaxH3ReferenceMediaFromPaths.name: VRGDG_MiniMaxH3ReferenceMediaFromPaths
VRGDG_MiniMaxH3ReferenceMediaFromPaths.display_name: VRGDG MiniMax H3 Reference Media From Paths
VRGDG_MiniMaxH3ReferenceMediaFromPaths.description: Builder-friendly ordered media loader for MiniMax H3. It accepts project/input/output paths, keeps each image and video in its own H3 reference slot, and returns None for unused slots.

ref_image_size.tooltip: Reference image sizing: match the generation canvas or preserve a larger identity reference.

ref_image.tooltip: Additional identity, outfit, or composition reference image.

VRGDG_MiniMaxH3ImageReferenceToVideo.name: VRGDG_MiniMaxH3ImageReferenceToVideo
VRGDG_MiniMaxH3ImageReferenceToVideo.display_name: MiniMax H3 Image + Reference to Video
VRGDG_MiniMaxH3ImageReferenceToVideo.description: Combined MiniMax H3 image-to-video and reference-image conditioning. First/last frames anchor the motion while reference images preserve identity, clothing, or other visual details.

prompt_format.tooltip: Wrap a normal image prompt for a static H3 burst, or pass an already-formatted H3 prompt unchanged.

edit_fidelity.tooltip: Prompt-level preservation guidance for the primary source image. H3 does not expose a numeric reference strength.

ref_image_size.tooltip: Match is faster; max retains more reference detail but can use substantially more VRAM.

source_image.tooltip: Primary image to edit. It becomes <Picture 1> but is not locked as a keyframe, allowing visible changes.

ref_image.tooltip: Optional supporting identity, outfit, object, environment, or style reference.

VRGDG_MiniMaxH3StillImage.name: VRGDG_MiniMaxH3StillImage
VRGDG_MiniMaxH3StillImage.display_name: MiniMax H3 Text / Reference to Image
VRGDG_MiniMaxH3StillImage.description: Uses MiniMax H3's minimum five-frame generation as a still-image burst. Connect source_image to edit an image through the H3 reference model; leave it empty for text-to-image. Decode the sampled latent with VAE Decode, then use MiniMax H3 Select Still Frame.

VRGDG_MiniMaxH3SelectStillFrame.name: VRGDG_MiniMaxH3SelectStillFrame
VRGDG_MiniMaxH3SelectStillFrame.description: Selects one frame from a decoded MiniMax H3 still-image burst. The center frame is the recommended default because it has temporal context on both sides.

sigmas.tooltip: Connect the same ManualSigmas used by the sampler.

VRGDG_LTXCFGSchedule.name: VRGDG_LTXCFGSchedule
VRGDG_LTXCFGSchedule.description: Creates one CFG value per transition in a connected LTX sigma schedule. Values outside the selected percentage range are 1.0. Connect this only to VRGDG LTX Scheduled CFG Guider.

cfg.tooltip: Connect the cfg output from VRGDG LTX CFG Schedule.

VRGDG_LTXScheduledCFGGuider.name: VRGDG_LTXScheduledCFGGuider
VRGDG_LTXScheduledCFGGuider.description: A schedule-aware replacement for ComfyUI's scalar CFG Guider. It selects one CFG value for each LTX sigma transition.

sigmas.tooltip: Connect the same ManualSigmas used by the sampler.

stg_blocks.tooltip: Comma-separated LTX transformer blocks to perturb.

VRGDG_LTXSigmaAdvancedGuider.name: VRGDG_LTXSigmaAdvancedGuider
VRGDG_LTXSigmaAdvancedGuider.description: One ManualSigmas-driven LTX guider with scheduled CFG/APG, STG, and variance rescale. APG replaces the CFG vector when selected; it is not stacked as a second guidance pass. Outside the active percentage range CFG is 1 and STG/rescale are 0.

sigmas.tooltip: Connect the same ManualSigmas used by the sampler.

influence_start.tooltip: 1 preserves the guide's original strength; 0 releases it.

VRGDG_LTXSigmaGuideRelease.name: VRGDG_LTXSigmaGuideRelease
VRGDG_LTXSigmaGuideRelease.description: Ramps LTX image/video-guide influence over the connected ManualSigmas. It scales both the guide's latent denoise lock and its per-guide attention. The start value is held before start_percent and the end value after end_percent. Value 1 preserves the original guide strength; 0 releases it.

preset.tooltip: Lower presets preserve the original video more closely. Higher presets create stronger detail, lighting, texture, and motion changes.

custom_sigmas.tooltip: Used only with Custom — Enter Your Own Values.

sigma_values.tooltip: Read-only preview of the selected sigma schedule.

VRGDG_LTX25SigmaPreset.name: VRGDG_LTX25SigmaPreset
VRGDG_LTX25SigmaPreset.description: LTX 2.5 sigma presets for enhancement and denoising. Enhance Only minimizes changes but cannot guarantee perfect preservation: LTX may still modify faces, motion, lighting, or textures during denoising.

video.tooltip: Current video batch as an IMAGE tensor.

batch_index.tooltip: Current batch number: 0 is the first batch, 1 is the second, and so on. Used to keep cached batch prompts separate.

frames_to_extract.tooltip: Number of representative frames sent to the vision model. Three means first, middle, and final frame. More frames provide more coverage but use more API tokens.

llm_runner.tooltip: Choose the same kind of LLM runner used by the Video Builder: LM Studio for a local server, LLM API for OpenAI/Anthropic/Google, or Custom Server for another OpenAI-compatible server.

llm_provider.tooltip: Provider used when llm_runner is LLM API. Choose the service that issued your API key, such as openai for an OpenAI key.

model_name.tooltip: Choose the vision model. The list changes with the selected API provider; LM Studio and Custom Server models are loaded from their server when available.

api_url.tooltip: Vision chat-completions endpoint. The default is for LM Studio. Other servers usually use an OpenAI-compatible /v1 endpoint.

api_key.tooltip: External API key. Usually leave blank for local LM Studio or Ollama unless authentication is enabled.

max_prompt_length.tooltip: Maximum characters in the generated prompt. Larger values allow more detail; 1200 is a concise default.

overlap_frames.tooltip: Optional frames from the end of the previous batch. They help maintain the same subject, clothing, props, and environment across batch boundaries.

overlap_frame_count.tooltip: Number of frames to use from overlap_frames. Leave at 0 when none are connected; 2 or 3 is usually enough.

video_filename.tooltip: Optional original filename used for stable caching. Reusing the same filename, batch, model, and frame settings avoids another API call.

VRGDG_VideoPromptReconstructor.name: VRGDG_VideoPromptReconstructor
VRGDG_VideoPromptReconstructor.description: Generate a concise, visually grounded prompt from representative frames of a video batch.

prompt.default: edit these images into a cinematic final image
prompt.tooltip: Text prompt sent to Google Flow after any connected input images are uploaded and added to the prompt. For edits, describe the final image you want Flow to create.

image_count.tooltip: How many image sockets this run should read, starting at image1. Use 0 for text-only Flow generation. Increase this when connecting multiple reference images.

debug_port.tooltip: Local Chrome remote-debugging port used by the automation. Leave 9222 unless another app is already using that port.

timeout_seconds.tooltip: Maximum time to let Flow run before ComfyUI gives up. Use a larger value for slow generations, uploads, or 2K downloads.

reuse_open_project.tooltip: When enabled, non-manual automation reuses the currently open Flow project/tab instead of navigating back to the Flow home page and clicking New project for every image.

VRGDG_FlowBrowserImageEdit.name: VRGDG_FlowBrowserImageEdit
VRGDG_FlowBrowserImageEdit.description: Automates Google Flow in Chrome. Optional dynamic image inputs are uploaded and added to the prompt; the downloaded result is returned as a ComfyUI IMAGE.

install_portable_node.tooltip: When enabled, setup downloads a private portable Node.js into this custom node folder. This lets users install without opening a command prompt or installing Node globally.

node_version.tooltip: Portable Node.js version to download. Leave this alone unless you specifically need another Node 18+ version.

install_if_missing.tooltip: When enabled, setup installs the JavaScript dependencies used by the Flow browser automation. Usually leave this on and run the setup node once.

strict_ssl.tooltip: Controls npm certificate checking while installing dependencies. False is more forgiving on machines with certificate issues; true is stricter.

timeout_seconds.tooltip: Maximum time allowed for setup downloads and installs. Increase this on slower internet connections.

VRGDG_FlowBrowserSetup.name: VRGDG_FlowBrowserSetup
VRGDG_FlowBrowserSetup.description: Checks and optionally installs portable Node.js plus the Playwright dependencies used by the VRGDG Flow Browser nodes.

prompt.default: create a cinematic image
prompt.tooltip: Prompt to paste into ChatGPT Images. Connected images are attached first, then this prompt is submitted.

image_count.tooltip: How many image sockets this run should attach, starting at image1. Use 0 for text-only generation.

Human-readable audit of the fields used.

preset.tooltip:
Caption presets choose WHAT style to request. Tuning presets choose HOW Music3 interprets it.

Balanced / Built-in Baseline: Neutral reference using Music3's familiar starting values. Expect balanced adherence and variation without pushing any stage; use this before judging another preset.
Balanced Quality: Adds rendering steps and slightly tightens planning. Tends to sound a little more finished and deliberate while remaining broadly balanced.
Raw Live Rock: Firm planning and stronger diffusion guidance with moderate plan emphasis. Tends toward decisive, energetic, punchy results; may become slightly rougher than baseline.
Lyrics + Structure Focus: Tighter AR choices and stronger text guidance. Tends to follow words and section labels more closely, with somewhat less melodic and arrangement freedom.
Creative Variations: Looser guidance, high planning diversity and gentler rendering. Tends to explore different melodies, phrasing and arrangements; lyrics or structure may wander more.
Intimate + Dry: Strong caption guidance, constrained planning and restrained diffusion. Tends toward focused, simpler and less explosive results that leave more room around the lead.
Aggressive + Dense: Higher diversity, rendering guidance, steps and plan strength. Tends toward thicker, more forceful and busier results; carries greater harshness or artifact risk.
Conservative / Stable: Constrained planning with lower diffusion and plan strength. Tends to produce steadier, cleaner and less adventurous results when stronger presets become unstable.
Strict Lyrics: The strongest lyric guidance with the narrowest token choice. Tends to prioritize word and line adherence; may sound more rigid or less inventive.
Strong Song Structure: High AR guidance, low diversity, extra steps and stronger plan emphasis. Tends to make verses, choruses and transitions more deliberate; may reduce spontaneity.
Creative Melody: Low AR guidance with high token diversity and moderate rendering. Tends to produce more surprising melodies and vocal phrasing while still retaining a usable structure.
Maximum Arrangement Variation: The loosest and most exploratory preset. Tends to create the largest changes in instrumentation, pacing and section treatment; has the highest drift risk.
Stable / Low Artifact: Constrained planning, restrained diffusion and reduced plan strength with extra steps. Tends to favor smooth, reliable rendering over impact or novelty.
Strong Acoustic Plan: Emphasizes a fairly focused hidden music plan during diffusion. Tends to sound decisive and tightly committed to the generated arrangement; excessive emphasis can sound harsh.
Loose Acoustic Plan: High planning diversity with low text, diffusion and plan strength. Tends to feel freer, softer and less locked-in; melody, lyrics and sections may drift.
Detailed Rendering: Keeps baseline composition behavior but raises diffusion steps substantially. Tends to refine texture and separation rather than rewrite the composition; slower to generate.
Long-Song Stability: Tighter planning, stronger text guidance and more rendering steps. Intended to help longer songs remain coherent across sections; may repeat ideas or feel less spontaneous.
Fast Draft: Uses only 20 rendering steps with otherwise moderate controls. Useful for quickly testing lyrics, captions and seeds; expect less refinement than a final render.
High-Energy / Dense: Strong diffusion, more steps, elevated diversity and plan emphasis. Tends toward louder-feeling, layered and high-impact arrangements; increased congestion or artifact risk.
Soft / Restrained: Focused AR planning with gentle diffusion and slightly reduced plan strength. Tends toward calmer dynamics, lighter density and less aggressive rendering.

VRGDG_Music3TuningPreset.name: VRGDG_Music3TuningPreset
VRGDG_Music3TuningPreset.description: Behavior-based presets for adherence, structure, variation, stability, plan strength, rendering detail, and speed. These remain independent from genre/style captions.
output_tooltips: Connect to Music3 Text Encode cfg_scale. Higher follows caption/lyrics more strongly while generating the AR plan.
Connect to Music3 Text Encode top_k. Lower is more constrained/repeatable; higher explores more token alternatives.
Connect to KSampler cfg. Controls denoiser guidance between the acoustic plan and zeroed conditioning.
Connect to KSampler steps. More steps can refine detail but do not guarantee better composition.
Connect through Music3 Conditioning Strength after Text Encode. Scales the acoustic plan presented to the DiT.
Preset-specific notes and explanations.

lyrics.tooltip: Lyrics only. Square-bracket section labels are structural hints; Verse 1 and Verse 2 are valid.

normalise_headers.tooltip: Converts recognized (), {}, or inconsistently capitalized section tags to canonical [Verse 1], [Pre-Chorus], etc.

remove_metadata_lines.tooltip: Removes lines beginning Genre:, Mood:, Style:, Tempo:, Instruments:, Production:, or Vocal: so Music3 does not try to sing them.

VRGDG_Music3LyricsPrepare.name: VRGDG_Music3LyricsPrepare
VRGDG_Music3LyricsPrepare.description: Normalizes recognized song-section headers, removes accidental metadata, and warns about bracket text Music3 may mistake for lyrics.

conditioning.tooltip: Acoustic conditioning from MiniMax Music3 Text Encode.

strength.tooltip: Directly scales Music3's acoustic hidden plan. 1.0 is built-in behavior; lower loosens it; higher emphasizes it and may become harsh or unstable.

VRGDG_Music3ConditioningStrength.name: VRGDG_Music3ConditioningStrength
VRGDG_Music3ConditioningStrength.description: Scales Music3's model-specific conditioning_scale metadata without altering the AR plan tensor.

conditioning_a.tooltip: Primary Music3 acoustic plan. For useful results, A and B should use the same lyrics, duration, and preferably the same seed.

conditioning_b.tooltip: Alternative Music3 acoustic plan from another caption or seed.

blend_b.tooltip: 0 uses only A; 1 uses only B. Intermediate values linearly blend the hidden acoustic plans. Experimental: some combinations can become incoherent.

length_mode.tooltip: Plans can end at different times. Cropping is safer; padding preserves the longer requested duration.

VRGDG_Music3ConditioningBlend.name: VRGDG_Music3ConditioningBlend
VRGDG_Music3ConditioningBlend.description: Experimental linear blend of two Music3 acoustic hidden plans. Best used for controlled same-lyrics A/B caption experiments.

base_seed.tooltip: Starting seed for repeatable A/B exploration.

VRGDG_Music3SeedBank.name: VRGDG_Music3SeedBank
VRGDG_Music3SeedBank.description: Creates four deterministic seed candidates. Keep one seed fixed while tuning parameters; change seeds only when exploring composition alternatives.

frame_count.tooltip: Optional explicit frame count (0 = auto-compute from latent tokens)

tail_padding_frames.tooltip: Frames at the end of this render that fall after the scene's visible last frame (alignment padding / cool-down). -1 = unknown. Lets the next scene's exact-frame continuation find the real last frame inside the latent.

VRGDG_MiniMaxH3SaveLatent.name: VRGDG_MiniMaxH3SaveLatent
VRGDG_MiniMaxH3SaveLatent.description: Serializes the raw MiniMax H3 sampled latent to <project_folder>/latents/scene_NNN.latent. Acts as a passthrough so it can be inserted seamlessly before VAE Decode.

scene_number.tooltip: Scene number to load (e.g. predecessor scene N-1)

context_frames.tooltip: Number of temporal context frames to slice from the tail (16, 22, 39, 56)

exact_frame_mode.tooltip: Cut the context so it ends just before the predecessor's real last visible frame (skipping any padding after it) on the model's 5-token grid, leaving that last frame to be supplied as an exact image.

VRGDG_MiniMaxH3LoadLatent.name: VRGDG_MiniMaxH3LoadLatent
VRGDG_MiniMaxH3LoadLatent.description: Loads scene_NNN.latent from disk, extracts the trailing context window based on the requested context frames, and returns the sliced latent tensor.

frame_idx.tooltip: Frame index where the continuation guide starts (typically 0)

include_audio.tooltip: Also anchor the predecessor's audio tail. Leave off when the scene audio is already driven by a source track (Audio Drive / audio reference); the predecessor audio would conflict with it at the same timeline position.

VRGDG_MiniMaxH3ApplyLatentGuide.name: VRGDG_MiniMaxH3ApplyLatentGuide
VRGDG_MiniMaxH3ApplyLatentGuide.display_name: VRGDG H3 Apply Latent Continuation Guide
VRGDG_MiniMaxH3ApplyLatentGuide.description: Bypasses pixel VAE encoding by attaching the raw predecessor latent directly into the conditioning keyframes (minimax_keyframes) at frame_idx=0. Video only by default.

context_frames.tooltip: Number of leading context frames to trim from the decoded output

VRGDG_MiniMaxH3TrimContinuation.name: VRGDG_MiniMaxH3TrimContinuation
VRGDG_MiniMaxH3TrimContinuation.description: Slices off the leading context frames so only newly generated frames remain for seamless downstream video assembly and timeline playback.

image_path.tooltip: Path to the image file, e.g. the previous scene's extracted last frame

VRGDG_MiniMaxH3LoadExactFrame.name: VRGDG_MiniMaxH3LoadExactFrame
VRGDG_MiniMaxH3LoadExactFrame.display_name: VRGDG H3 Load Exact Last Frame
VRGDG_MiniMaxH3LoadExactFrame.description: Loads a single image file as a 1-frame IMAGE batch for the exact last-frame anchor.

model.tooltip: YuE2-3B local model folder or Hugging Face repository ID.

vae.tooltip: YuE2 VAE decoder folder or repository ID used to convert latents into 48 kHz stereo audio.

device.tooltip: CUDA is required for practical generation. Auto chooses an available device; CPU is mainly diagnostic.

backend.tooltip: torch uses fast CUDA graphs. torch-eager is a slower troubleshooting fallback.

quantization.tooltip: none uses validated BF16 weights. FP8 is experimental and can affect compatibility and quality.

offload_ar.tooltip: Move unused AR modules to system RAM during synthesis to save VRAM at the cost of transfer time.

local_files_only.tooltip: Require local files and prevent Hugging Face network downloads during generation.

cache_dir.tooltip: Optional directory for downloaded Hugging Face snapshots and metadata.

verify_hashes.tooltip: Hash all model weights before every run. More integrity checking, but slow on large weights and non-SSD storage.

yue2_config.tooltip: Runtime configuration from YuE2 Installer + Settings or YuE2 Settings.

models_text.default:
The Evaluate Integers, Floats, and Strings nodes 
now employ the SimpleEval library, enabling secure 
creation and execution of custom Python expressions.

(https://github.com/danthedeckie/simpleeval)

Below is a short list of what is possible.
______________________________________________

"EVALUATE INTEGERS/FLOATS" NODE EXPRESSION EXAMPLES:

Addition: a + b + c
Subtraction: a - b - c
Multiplication: a * b * c
Division: a / b / c
Modulo: a % b % c
Exponentiation: a ** b ** c
Floor Division: a // b // c
Absolute Value: abs(a) + abs(b) + abs(c)
Maximum: max(a, b, c)
Minimum: min(a, b, c)
Sum of Squares: a**2 + b**2 + c**2
Bitwise And: a & b & c
Bitwise Or: a | b | c
Bitwise Xor: a ^ b ^ c
Left Shift: a << 1 + b << 1 + c << 1
Right Shift: a >> 1 + b >> 1 + c >> 1
Greater Than Comparison: a > b > c
Less Than Comparison: a < b < c
Equal To Comparison: a == b == c
Not Equal To Comparison: a != b != c
______________________________________________

"EVALUATE STRINGS" NODE EXPRESSION EXAMPLES:

Concatenate: a + b + c
Format: f'{a} {b} {c}'
Length: len(a) + len(b) + len(c)
Uppercase: a.upper() + b.upper() + c.upper()
Lowercase: a.lower() + b.lower() + c.lower()
Capitalize: a.capitalize() + b.capitalize() + c.capitalize()
Title Case: a.title() + b.title() + c.title()
Strip: a.strip() + b.strip() + c.strip()
Find Substring: a.find('sub') + b.find('sub') + c.find('sub')
Replace Substring: a.replace('old', 'new') + b.replace('old', 'new') + c.replace('old', 'new')
Count Substring: a.count('sub') + b.count('sub') + c.count('sub')
Check Numeric: a.isnumeric() + b.isnumeric() + c.isnumeric()
Check Alphabetic: a.isalpha() + b.isalpha() + c.isalpha()
Check Alphanumeric: a.isalnum() + b.isalnum() + c.isalnum()
Check Start: a.startswith('prefix') + b.startswith('prefix') + c.startswith('prefix')
Check End: a.endswith('suffix') + b.endswith('suffix') + c.endswith('suffix')
Split: a.split(' ') + b.split(' ') + c.split(' ')
Zero Fill: a.zfill(5) + b.zfill(5) + c.zfill(5)
Slice: a[:5] + b[:5] + c[:5]
Reverse: a[::-1] + b[::-1] + c[::-1]
______________________________________________

MiniMaxH3LatentUpscale.name: MiniMaxH3LatentUpscale
MiniMaxH3LatentUpscale.description: Spatially upscale a MiniMax H3 video LATENT. Use after LTXVSeparateAVLatent (audio is not touched by this node). Snaps H/W to the DiT's 2x2 patch grid.

MiniMaxH3ConditioningUpscale.name: MiniMaxH3ConditioningUpscale
MiniMaxH3ConditioningUpscale.description: Rescale minimax_refs / minimax_keyframes visual latents in CONDITIONING to track a paired MiniMaxH3LatentUpscale pass. No-op (safe to leave wired) if neither is present. Use the same scale_by/upscale_method as the paired node.

MiniMaxH3AddNoise.name: MiniMaxH3AddNoise
MiniMaxH3AddNoise.description: AddNoise for continuing a CONST/flow-parameterized model (e.g. MiniMax H3) into a second SamplerCustomAdvanced pass via DisableNoise. Stock AddNoise's output gets scaled down again by (1-sigma) inside the second sampler's own internal noise_scaling call (which runs even with DisableNoise's zero noise) -- this divides by (1-sigma) first (inverse_noise_scaling) so the two cancel out. Without this, higher denoise values on the second pass produce near-pure noise instead of a refined image.

MiniMaxH3ShiftSigmas.name: MiniMaxH3ShiftSigmas
MiniMaxH3ShiftSigmas.description: Remaps a video-schedule SIGMAS array onto MiniMax H3's audio schedule, for feeding the audio branch's MiniMaxH3AddNoise on a pass-2 resample. The DiT internally runs audio on its own shift (default 3.0) while the sampler's sigmas are on the video shift (default 12.0, matching the checkpoint's sampling_settings) -- noising audio with the raw video sigma puts far more noise into it than the model expects at that point in the schedule, which reads as audio distortion. Use the same shift_video/shift_audio as any MiniMaxH3SigmaShift node upstream, or leave at defaults if none is used.

What is the subject of this image?
What are the mediums used to make this?
What are the artistic styles this is reminiscent of?

Krea2AnyPaintPrepare.name: Krea2AnyPaintPrepare
Krea2AnyPaintPrepare.description: Place the source without resizing it. Padding and white mask pixels are generated; black mask pixels are preserved. The source image's Mask Editor output can be connected directly to generated_mask.

Krea2AnyPaintEncode.name: Krea2AnyPaintEncode
Krea2AnyPaintEncode.description: Encode the full-canvas semantic reference and create a standard Comfy latent/noise_mask pair. KSampler performs timestep-matched known-region replacement; no final source composite is used.

Krea2AnyPaintModelPatch.name: Krea2AnyPaintModelPatch
Krea2AnyPaintModelPatch.description: Register the semantic reference over the complete target canvas and cache its isolated K/V once per sampling run. Place after Load LoRA.

chunk_length.tooltip: Max frames per chunk (model limit 81). Must be 4n+1.

overlap.tooltip: Frames from the previous chunk used as anchor. SCAIL-2 trained at 5.

seed_mode.tooltip: increment: chunk i uses noise_seed+i. fixed: same seed every chunk.

color_transfer.tooltip: Reinhard LAB color match of each extension chunk to the last frame of the previous chunk (fights drift).

SCAILAutoExtend.name: SCAILAutoExtend
SCAILAutoExtend.description: Generates the full video in one go: samples the first chunk, then automatically loops as many extension chunks as the pose video needs, anchoring each on the last frames of the previous chunk, and stitches the result. Replaces the manual extension sections.

model.tooltip: SAM3 model (same one feeding SAM3_VideoTrack).

image.tooltip: Frame to segment, at the resolution the tracker runs on (resized reference image, or pose video's first frame).

mode.tooltip: points: one positive click per person (from a PointsEditor). boxes: one bounding box per person.

refine_iterations.tooltip: SAM decoder refinement passes per object (0 = raw prompt mask).

points.tooltip: points mode: JSON list, one positive point per person, e.g. [{"x":120,"y":210},{"x":480,"y":205}]. Order sets identity order.

bboxes.tooltip: boxes mode: one bounding box per person. Order sets identity order.

SCAIL2IdentitySeeder.name: SCAIL2IdentitySeeder
SCAIL2IdentitySeeder.description: One mask per person from point or box prompts -> SAM3_VideoTrack.initial_mask. Guarantees one tracked object (one colour) per subject, bypassing the auto-detector's overlap-merging. Leave SAM3_VideoTrack conditioning disconnected.

reference_image.tooltip: Processed reference (post background-removal + padding), at model resolution.

pose_video.tooltip: Driving/pose video frames, at the resolution fed to the sampler.

refine_iterations.tooltip: SAM decoder refinement passes per seed.

auto_detect.tooltip: Master switch for text detection. When on, reference_conditioning / driving_conditioning (if connected) drive SAM3 text detection on that side, alongside any drawn boxes.

markers.tooltip: Canvas markers (JSON). Managed by the node's canvas widget.

reference_conditioning.tooltip: Optional CLIPTextEncode (e.g. 'person') to auto-detect identities on the reference image instead of / alongside drawn boxes. Needs auto_detect on. Text-only loses explicit colour ordering.

driving_conditioning.tooltip: Optional CLIPTextEncode to auto-detect / append people on the driving video. Needs auto_detect on.

SCAIL2IdentityTracker.name: SCAIL2IdentityTracker
SCAIL2IdentityTracker.description: Draw ordered points/boxes per person on the reference image and driving video, get ref_track_data + driving_track_data out. Play button previews the frames without tracking (partial execution). Auto-detect adds latecomers.

length.tooltip: Generation length in frames. Must match the WanSCAILToVideo length.

replacement_mode.tooltip: Must match WanSCAILToVideo. Replacement composites each ref on black; animation uses the full frame.

image_1.tooltip: Single character -> palette colour 0. Order must match the driving colours.

mask_1.tooltip: Silhouette for image_1 (e.g. RMBG mask). Optional; defaults to the whole frame.

image_2.tooltip: Single character -> palette colour 1. Order must match the driving colours.

mask_2.tooltip: Silhouette for image_2 (e.g. RMBG mask). Optional; defaults to the whole frame.

image_3.tooltip: Single character -> palette colour 2. Order must match the driving colours.

mask_3.tooltip: Silhouette for image_3 (e.g. RMBG mask). Optional; defaults to the whole frame.

image_4.tooltip: Single character -> palette colour 3. Order must match the driving colours.

mask_4.tooltip: Silhouette for image_4 (e.g. RMBG mask). Optional; defaults to the whole frame.

image_5.tooltip: Single character -> palette colour 4. Order must match the driving colours.

mask_5.tooltip: Silhouette for image_5 (e.g. RMBG mask). Optional; defaults to the whole frame.

image_6.tooltip: Single character -> palette colour 5. Order must match the driving colours.

mask_6.tooltip: Silhouette for image_6 (e.g. RMBG mask). Optional; defaults to the whole frame.

SCAIL2MultiReference.name: SCAIL2MultiReference
SCAIL2MultiReference.description: EXPERIMENTAL: stack up to 6 single-character images as separate reference frames (image_1->blue, image_2->red, ...) to test colour-based identity binding. Wire after WanSCAILToVideo (reference left empty), before SamplerCustom.

model.tooltip:
The diffusion model.
If you are using any other attn2 replacer (such as `IPAdapter`), you should place this node after it.

negative.tooltip: Negative conditioning: either the one you use for CFG or a completely different one.

scale.tooltip: Scale of NAG, does nothing when `tau=0`.

tau.tooltip: Normalization threshold, larger value should increase `scale` impact.

alpha.tooltip: Linear interpolation between original (at `alpha=0`) and NAG (at `alpha=1`) results.

unet_block_list.tooltip:
Comma-separated blocks to which NAG is being applied to. When the list is empty, NAG is being applied to all block.
Read README from sd-perturbed-attention for more details.

NormalizedAttentionGuidance.name: NormalizedAttentionGuidance
NormalizedAttentionGuidance.description:
An additional way to apply negative prompts to the image.
It's compatible with CFG, PAG, and other guidances, and can be used with guidance- and step-distilled models as well.
It's also compatible with other attn2 replacers (such as `IPAdapter`) - but make sure to place NAG node **after** other model patches!

unet_block_list.tooltip: Blocks to which TPG is applied.

Comma-separated blocks to which Pladis is being applied to. When the list is empty, PLADIS is being applied to all `u` and `d` blocks.
Read README from sd-perturbed-attention for more details.

low_res_model.tooltip: Low-resolution model used for the first transition_step evaluations. Also used for the high-resolution stage when high_res_model is disconnected.

vae.tooltip: Video VAE used for the pixel re-encode anchor at the resolution transition.

latent_image.tooltip: Target-resolution H3 AV latent defining size and duration. Experimental: accepts existing latents, Tensor masks and H3 NestedTensor video/audio masks. 0 keeps content; 1 generates. With highres_tiling, masks must be video=1 everywhere and audio=0 everywhere.

sampler.tooltip: Standard Euler only; SelfLift reuses its transition-step prediction to keep the original NFE count.

transition_step.tooltip: Number of low-resolution denoiser evaluations. The paper uses 6 of 8 NFEs for its 8-step image model; H3 requires independent validation.

lowres_scale.tooltip: Spatial scale of the low-resolution prefix (paper: 0.5).

rho.tooltip: Fraction of highest-risk spatiotemporal locations corrected toward the pixel-VAE anchor. The H3 default 0 uses only the external latent upscaler and skips the VAE round trip. For SelfLift-zero with upscaler_model=none, start near 0.6.

w_min.tooltip: Correction-strength floor. H3's widespread nearest-lift error can require 1.0; 0.5 is the paper's image-model setting.

w_max.tooltip: Correction-strength ceiling. Keep at 1.0 for the H3 SelfLift-zero diagnostic.

upscaler_model.tooltip: External H3 latent upscaler (models/latent_upscale_models). The first detected H3 model is selected by default; 'none' uses nearest-neighbor lifting.

high_res_model.tooltip: 高分辨率阶段模型 / High-resolution model. Used after the resolution lift. If disconnected, uses low_res_model. Both stages must use compatible architecture, latent format, sampling parameterization, VAE and conditioning.

highres_tiling.tooltip: Experimental: spatial tiling; auto/manual controls below. 1 tile means no split. Masks supported only for video=1 everywhere / audio=0 everywhere. Every tile receives complete audio and audio conditioning. Without masks, only the first tile audio prediction is retained. Quality and speed may change.

tiling_mode.tooltip: auto 自动: choose 1–8 tiles using memory estimates. manual 手动: use tiling_tiles, no automatic increase. Only active when highres_tiling is on.

tiling_tiles.tooltip: 手动块数 / Manual tiles: 2, 4, 6, 8. Ignored in auto mode. Turn highres_tiling off for full-frame processing. Small dimensions can reduce the effective count. Does not guarantee enough VRAM.

tiling_axis.tooltip: 分块方向 / Spatial direction: auto = longer patch-grid side; width = left/right strips; height = top/bottom strips. Used by both auto and manual modes; audio/time are not split.

low_res_model.tooltip: Low-resolution model used for the first transition_step evaluations. Also used for the high-resolution stage when high_res_model is disconnected.

vae.tooltip: VAE used for the pixel re-encode anchor at the resolution transition.

latent_image.tooltip: Target-resolution image latent. Experimental: accepts existing content and BHW/BCHW Tensor masks. 0 keeps content; 1 generates.

sampler.tooltip: Standard Euler only; SelfLift reuses its transition-step prediction to keep the original NFE count.

transition_step.tooltip: Number of low-resolution denoiser evaluations. Paper: 3 of 4 for FLUX.2-Klein, 6 of 8 for Z-Image-Turbo.

lowres_scale.tooltip: Spatial scale of the low-resolution prefix (paper: 0.5).

rho.tooltip: Fraction of locations corrected toward the pixel-VAE anchor. Paper: 0.4 for FLUX.2-Klein, 0.3 for Z-Image-Turbo.

latent_upsample.tooltip: Interpolation for the direct latent lift (paper: nearest).

high_res_model.tooltip: 高分辨率阶段模型 / High-resolution model. Used after the resolution lift. If disconnected, uses low_res_model. Both stages must use compatible architecture, latent format, sampling parameterization, VAE and conditioning.

tau.tooltip: Homeostatic correction strength; 0.2 is the paper setting. 0 disables correction while keeping the diagnostic active.

log_diagnostics.tooltip: Log per-forward Spectral Tension and correction statistics to the console. Note: TST is skipped with a warning when highres_tiling is enabled on the SelfLift sampler.

usage_notes.default:
用于解码 tt img enc 加密的无密码图片
此节点仅用于用户隐私保护，使用即承诺合法合规使用本工具，自愿承担全部风险与责任

图像反向节点
支持水平翻转、垂直翻转和同时翻转
适用于图像数据增强和特殊效果处理

图像颜色反向节点
支持完全反转、仅RGB反转、保留透明度反转
适用于创建负片效果和特殊视觉效果

图像转灰度节点
支持多种灰度转换方法：
- luminance: 亮度加权法（推荐）
- average: 平均值法
- red/green/blue: 单通道法
- max/min: 最大值/最小值法

图像亮度和对比度调节节点
亮度调节范围：-1.0 到 1.0（0.0为原始亮度）
对比度调节范围：0.0 到 3.0（1.0为原始对比度）
适用于图像增强和视觉效果调整

RGB三色相调节节点
支持独立调节红、绿、蓝三个通道
调节范围：-1.0 到 1.0（0.0为原始值）
正值增强该颜色，负值减弱该颜色
适用于色彩校正和艺术效果制作

HSV色彩调节节点
色相调节：-180°到180°（0°为原始色相）
饱和度调节：0.0到3.0（1.0为原始饱和度）
明度调节：0.0到3.0（1.0为原始明度）
适用于色彩风格转换和艺术效果制作

output_image.tooltip: IC-Light 等 relighting 模型的出图。

target_mask.tooltip: 人物 mask，只在此区域内分析光影。

output_normal.tooltip: （推荐）对 IC-Light 出图新跑一次 DSINE 得到的法线。接入后反推出图实际光向，可与参考做夹角对比。不接则跳过光向反推，仅做光影统计。

reference_profile.tooltip: （推荐）参考图 profile。接入后做参考→出图一致性对照评分。

color_constancy.tooltip: 白平衡（剥离光源色偏）。诊断时建议与 RST_LogShadingExtract 用同样的设置。

base_positive.tooltip: 你已有的正向词，会拼到自动 lighting tag 前。

base_negative.tooltip: 你已有的负向词，会拼到自动 lighting tag 前。

black_point.tooltip: 暗于此值的拉成纯黑。提高 → 阴影更深。

white_point.tooltip: 亮于此值的拉成纯白。降低 → 高光更亮。

gamma.tooltip: <1 提中间调，>1 压中间调。

contrast.tooltip: S 曲线对比度。0=直通；越大黑白越分明。

target_mask.tooltip: （可选）只在人物 mask 内拉对比度，背景保持原样。

target_normal.tooltip: （可选）目标法线图。接入后 PDSE 会启用 lambert 通道，剥离更准。

color_constancy.tooltip: 白平衡方法。建议与项目里其他 LogShadingExtract / Profile 节点保持一致。

strip_strength.tooltip: 剥离强度。1.0=完全剥离（最忠实）；<1.0=保留部分原图光影（更安全，伪影少）。

yyz_AlbedoExtract_v2.name: yyz_AlbedoExtract_v2
yyz_AlbedoExtract_v2.display_name: yyz Albedo Extract v2 (strip baked lighting)

strength.tooltip: 整体强度倍率。1.0=严格按 reference_profile；>1 加强阴影/高光，<1 减弱。

ambient.tooltip: 环境光底。0=纯方向光（最强阴影），1=平光（无方向）；0.3 适合大多数人像。

target_normal.tooltip: （可选）目标法线。接入后 PDSE 启用 lambert 通道，本色干扰剩离更准。

match_strength.tooltip: 校准强度。1.0=严格对齐参考（数学保证）；<1.0=部分对齐（保留更多原图特征）。

soft_clip_max.tooltip: 缩放系数上限。防止极端缩放（原图近乎平光时除以 ~0 会爆炸）。3.0 适合大多数场景。

statistic_source.tooltip: 统计提取方法。pdse=与 ReferenceProfile 一致，本色无关（推荐）；naive_luma=裸 luma 统计，快但有衣服色干扰。

color_constancy.tooltip: PDSE 内部白平衡。建议与 ReferenceProfile / LogShadingExtract 保持一致。

calibrate_direction.tooltip: two_way=严格对齐参考（目标比参考立体时会被压平）；boost_only=只增强不足的光影、不压平目标原有的立体（缩放系数下限锁到 1.0）。参考图偏平/低对比时推荐 boost_only。

yyz_StatisticalCalibrate_v2.name: yyz_StatisticalCalibrate_v2
yyz_StatisticalCalibrate_v2.display_name: yyz Statistical Calibrate v2 (end-goal SH match)

exposure_neutralize.tooltip: 曝光中性化：扣除 mask 内的 delta 均值，让本节点只迁移明暗结构（立体）、不改整体亮度。1.0=纯结构迁移；0.0=保留整体曝光偏移（旧行为）。整体亮度/对比度交给 StatisticalCalibrate。
